title: Et Tu, Druckenmiller?
summary: Yesterday, I had two column ideas in mind. Although I touched upon my concerns about the Treasury’s recent intervention into the market for its long-dated bonds, I opted for the more timely topic of the failure of US-Canada trade talks. While I don’t regret that decision, I had planned to delve more deeply into the topic of the bond market today. That will still be the case, but the discussion has now been shaped by famed investor Stanley Druckenmiller’s op-ed in this morning's Wall Street Journal.
